dialogs.content: ...Now, now, there's no need to be so stubborn about this. I'll adjust the budget here, and we'll definitely turn a profit.
No. We must confirm the official representative before discussing details. There is an order to this that must be followed.
From the way she's talking... This must be the Shogun, right?
Yeah, it's her alright.
Ah, little one. It's about time. Come, I have a contract for you to sign.
Whoa! We're not just gonna sign a random contract out of the blue!
Also, if it's one of your contracts...
Hardly, hardly... Well, "labor" is a part of it, but you will be compensated...
Hah, so it IS as bad as Paimon thought...
#I see, so {F#s}he's the representative you selected... {M#He}{F#She} would indeed be the perfect candidate for the Mikawa Flower Festival.
The Mikawa Flower Festival?
When the youkai still roamed the land, they celebrated an event known as the "Mikawa Flower Festival." It was an occasion for drink, laughter, and merriment.
We hosted a version of it during the Test of Courage. Unfortunately, due to time constraints, we weren't able to put on a large celebration.
So, I got to thinking, why not have another go? This time, with a Mikawa Flower Festival for youkai and humans alike.
One that combines human ingenuity with youkai arts to offer the most innovative and thrilling entertainment of our time.... open to all humans and youkai throughout the land.
Entertainment, huh... Wait, kind of like Akitsu Yuugei and Akitsu Haneasobi? Those games were really fun!

For an important event like this, an official representative is required to preside over the festivities. In the past, the role was usually given to the Guuji, or an individual from the Yashiro Commission. But this time...
Neither myself nor the Kamisato family can assume the position, given we represent one side or the other — the youkai or the humans.
But, aren't I human, too?
Human you may be, but you posses a deep connection with the youkai, and you do not hail from this land. That makes you a more neutral option.
Moreover, you took part in the previous festival during the Test of Courage. In my estimation, there is no better candidate for the role.
Plus, your name has the potential to attract an even greater showing... So, are you going to sign this thing, or what?
Huh, you've got a point... Then, let's go ahead and... Wait! Paimon almost fell into her trap!
I don't work as a festival ambassador for free.
Come now, this is for an important occasion, is it not? Even I've chosen to throw profit to the wind. Surely a... selfless hero like yourself wouldn't turn your back on a good cause?
According to the proposal, the proceeds will be distributed as follows — forty percent to Yae Publishing House and ten percent to the festival representative.
Hey, no fair!
I want thirty percent.
Now, ten percent might not sound like much, but Yae Publishing House is going to great lengths for this occasion, both in time and personnel. All you need to do is show your face.
...You say that now, and then you're going to put me to work once I agree.
Hah, getting smart, aren't you, little one? In that case, I'll throw in another ten percent from the other half of the proceeds.
No. The other half is going to the Shogunate — that is not up for negotiation. But, I am rather curious about the supposed "great lengths" you mentioned...
Unless I am mistaken, most of the personnel and supplies are to be provided by the Shogunate. In that sense, forty percent seems rather high for your establishment, does it not?
That Ei... When did she reprogram you to argue back like this?
#Proceeds should be distributed according to contribution. Besides, from the very beginning, you planned to allocate an additional ten percent of your share to {NICKNAME}, did you not?
Wait, so earlier... you were just trying to shortchange us!
*sigh* What's the fun in bargaining if you open up with your best offer right off the bat?
Uh... Paimon doesn't see the fun at all, but twenty percent is... acceptable.
Alright, so what do I have to do as the representative?
Once the representative is confirmed, the rest of the conversation goes quite smoothly.
Games have always been a central part of the festival, and both Akitsu Haneasobi and Akitsu Yuugei were extremely popular.
So, the plan is to host an event where the attendees have forty-eight hours to create a game of their own. We'll have new and exciting entertainment in no time!
Ohh! Everyone loves fun games! You won't have to worry about attracting humans and youkai to the event!
That is the general plan. I'll leave you to iron out the finer details and contact the participants.
This is a critical time for the Shogunate's new development plans, and the survey team is returning momentarily, so I must turn my attention to them.
Got it, got it. We'll see you later, then.
Where to now?
Hmm... Chinju Forest. Let's pay a visit to our old friend, Ioroi.
How much are you willing to offer?
How can I be sure I'm not signing myself up for slave labor or something?
Eek! The smell of humans... Nothing to see here, just a statue... Huh? Wait, why do I smell kitsune...
Remember us, Ioroi?
Ah! It's you youngsters... And... YOU! Hmph, the nasty kitsune who turned Chinju Forest into the playground for her Test of Courage!
Oh, Chinju Forest is supposed to be Ioroi's territory, right? No wonder he's so mad...
Exactly! How could you hold a Test of Courage without inviting me!?
Ohhhhhh, so THAT's what he's angry about!
But, um, sealed away like this...
...*ahem* Anyway, what brings you all here? Something to discuss?
(Okay, so he avoided the question completely...)
Hehe, I actually came to apologize about the Test of Courage.
It was my mistake not to invite more youkai to the ceremony. So, for this Mikawa Flower Festival, I knew I had to extend a personal invitation to the bake-danuki.
Huh? The Mikawa Flower Festival?
Yes!!! The Mikawa Flower Festival!!!
Yes!!! The Mikawa Flower Festival!!!
Huh!? Kichiboushi, Shousei, Gyoubu Koban... Where did you come from!?
(And why can we understand them all of a sudden...)
Hmph! Never trust an apology from a kitsune! Or an invitation, for that matter! It's just a silly festival... So what if there's delicious food!? Or fun games!?
Yum yum!
Fun fun!
That's enough, you two! Don't fall for the kitsune's cheap tricks! Such hopeless innocent cubs...
What a shame... I was hoping to take you all to the festival, but it would seem Ioroi disapproves.
I suppose it makes sense... Poor Ioroi, stuck in this statue all alone while the rest of you got to have fun. How sad that would be...
Poor Ioroi!
E—Excuse you! I am Ioroi, the Kakushigami of the bake-danuki! I'm just... um... Ah, yes! Just worried the cubs will get distracted and stray from the tanuki path...
Ah, I should also mention, I was hoping the bake-danuki could help the humans take their games to the next level, talented as you are in the art of transformation.
In Inazuma, only the bake-danuki can hope to match the kitsune in that area.
Match!? The kitsune could never rival the transformative gifts of the bake-danuki!
...Ah, well, I was thinking of using the bake-danuki as the symbol of the event in promotions and such. But, alas, it would seem you don't like that idea, Ioroi.
No matter — I shall simply seek the help of the kitsune. When the time comes, all of Inazuma will know the kitsune stepped in to accomplish what the bake-danuki could not...
W—Wait!
Heh.
What an obvious strategy...
It worked, didn't it?
Ahem... My dear cubs, transforming into things that already exist is only a small fraction of what it means to become a great bake-danuki...
To even get a quarter of the way through your training, you must be able to turn into things of your own invention, just like when I turned into a gigantic ramen bowl that could fly...
So, go forth and seize this opportunity, so you can advance the name of the... Ah, no, I mean, advance your training!
Not all humans are bad and scary — some are good, just like these youngsters. Go with them and transform into things you've never tried before.
Don't worry, Ioroi. The little tanuki are safe with me.
You're the one I'm worried about...
Well, we're here, too! We'll make sure they don't, uh... stray from the path!
Hm... I'll hold you to that! Now, Kichiboushi, Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, while you're out there, always listen to—
Yep yep! Always listen to White Fur!
#And {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Yellow Fur!
And Auntie Pink—
...*ahem* Miss Pink Fur!
Ah, I almost forgot, given their level of training, speaking to humans will be a problem. Just a moment, I'll cook up a few Bake-Danuki Meals to keep on hand.
No need. Here, Miss Pink Fur prepared a special Kitsune Meal for you all. It will give you the ability to speak to humans.
Mm!? Y—You stole our tricks, too? A—And changed the name!?
Seemingly oblivious to Ioroi's loud sounds of protest, Miko prepares a completely non-suspicious feast...
Mm! Yum yum!
Nom nom! Mmm!
*sigh*... Is it really that much better than mine...?
Splendid! That should make our lives easier. Now, we can head into the city and start forming the teams.
Teams?
Well, we need more than bake-danuki power to design these games... Hmm, two humans per team should suffice, I'd say.
Now, I need to discuss the layout of the venue with the Yashiro Commission. I'll leave the team recruitment to you.
Put to work already...
Hold on, you're not taking part, Miko? You're really gonna sit out on the fun? You, of all people...
Hehe, making games is nowhere near as fun as playing them. Besides, working through the night certainly isn't my idea of a good time.
Making games?
Working?
Through the night?
...Anyway, this time, I'm going to wait for the fun to come to me. See you later, little ones.
Guess I need to earn that extra ten percent...
(Is it because of the Kitsune Meal? On second thought, better not to ask.)
Could you even participate?
Eek! A city!
So many houses! So many humans!
Gotta farm beans! White Fur, Yellow Fur, how do we farm beans?
Form teams not "farm beans"! Uh... It's kind of hard to explain...
It's like, finding people with similar interests.
Yeah, that's right! People with the same taste. Y'know, into the same thing. It's easier to come up with a game that way.
Taste the same... Got it!
Easy peasy! White Fur, dumb.
Farm beans that taste the same!
No, wait! That's not... And, they're gone. In different directions, too! *sigh* Let's go after them!
White Fur! Yellow Fur! Over here! Kichiboushi found big, sleepy tanuki!
Hate to break it to you Kichiboushi, but...
Hey... I'm a mujina, not a tanuki!
...Ohhh, mujina youkai that can turn into tanuki?
No, wait... I'm not a mujina or a tanuki. I'm Sayu!
Tanuki... Mujina... Sayu... So many transformations! Sayu is youkai?
She's a ninja, not a youkai.
I don't transform at all! I've been a human this whole time! Who is this guy, anyway? Popping up out of nowhere right when I found a spot to sleep...
Ehehe... Sorry, this is probably the first time Kichiboushi has ever seen a ninja...
Ah, the Big Tanuki and the Great Mujina Youkai are facing off! The rumors around Hanamizaka were true!
Not this again... It's just Sayu!
Oh... Haha, no youkai, huh. My bad, Sayu. I rushed over here as soon as I heard the rumors. Guess I got a bit carried away...
*whimper*... And there goes my nap...
Hahaha, silly humans. Much to learn.
Whoa, hold on... Is this guy... a real youkai!?
His name is Kichiboushi.
Well, hello there, Kichiboushi!
Mm! This human... really really warm!
Uh... warm?
Warm... personality-wise, I'm guessing?
Oh, hahaha... Well, what brings you to Inazuma City, Kichiboushi? We don't often get bake-danuki around these parts.
Boy, where do we begin...
You briefly explain the situation to Yoimiya.
Ahhh, I see. You're recruiting people to develop games for the Mikawa Flower Festival...
You interested?
Well, duh! C'mon, Sayu! Let's do it together!
...Ugh! Right when I was trying to run...
About that... um... I'm pretty busy... uh... practicing ninjutsu and such...
Oh, I heard the bake-danuki are great at ninjutsu! Rumors has it, with a single thought, they can grow taller than a house! Is that true, Kichiboushi?
Taller than a house? I've never heard of a ninjutsu like that...
It's not ninjutsu, it's bake-danuki art! We don't grow taller than house!
S—See...? I knew it wouldn't be that easy...
We grow taller than mountain!
EH!?
Sayu...?
S—Sorry... Just thinking about something sensei always said: "You can't just focus on drills, Sayu. You need to push the limits of what you know about ninjutsu."
Well, this is as good an opportunity as any.
I... I guess...
Farm beans, success?
A—Alright, let's go discuss this ninjutsu... Ah, no. This bake-danuki art of transformation! The one you're going to use for the festival!
Yes! I've always wanted to go to a festival with you, Sayu! Let's go to my place to brainstorm! We can even set off some fireworks when we're done!
Uh... I'll pass on the fireworks. They're terrible for my sleep...
...Wait, you're saying he's not one of Ushi's friends?
Whoa, pump the brakes... I thought he was your friend.
Hehe, long-horned oni and short-horned oni!
He... He talks!
Shousei! There you are!
White Fur! Yellow Fur! Shousei found White Fur and Yellow Fur number two. Both great youkai! Both like to play!
Great youkai... So, he thinks I'm an oni, too?
What's going on?
Listen, I was just playin' some Genius Invokation with my good bro Thoma during his time off...
And then, out of the blue, this... Shousei appeared right in the middle of our match.
Shousei loves to play! Long-horned and short-horned Oni also love to play! We taste the same, hehe!
We what now?
I can explain...
You briefly explain the situation to Itto and Thoma...
Oho! The Mikawa Flower Festival! Shoulda opened with that, compadre!
Man, the Arataki Gang really hard-carried the last one. We'll turn this one into somethin' special, too!
Hitotsume Kozou and the others did all the work, Bull-chucker. You're really lumping them in with your gang?
I—It's called doing them a favor... Besides, they look up to me. I'm like a cool older brother...
Hmm... Hitotsume Kozou and his friends did come up with the Akitsu Yuugei game during the last festival. There's no reason not to invite them this time!
Woo, the crew's gettin' back together! I'll round 'em up, hahaha!
...Technically, I'm on vacation, but I'm happy to assist the Yashiro Commission with the festival.
That's what I like to hear! Alright, let's round up those three little fellas and start workin' on the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Akitsu Yuugei Game...
Not so fast.
...Hornless oni?
We have an advertising job to finish, remember, Boss?
Huh?? We... We do!?
Re-shoots, follow-up work... There's still a mountain of things to do.
Oh, well... uh...

*ahem* Look at Thoma here, kind enough to help with the festival even during his vacation. I would think the Boss of the Arataki Gang would show even more dedication to his work, but y'know, that's just me...
Uhh... Umm...
Hah... Looks like your time is spoken for, my friend.
Wrap up what you need to do, and we can finish our match at the festival. Best of both worlds!
*sigh*... Alright! Those errands are a piece of cake. I'll be back in no time!
Oh, but first, I should introduce you to Kozou and the others. Then, you can head to the festival... without me.
#Then, let's get a move on! No use standing here talking about it — go make those introductions. We have stuff to do... Sorry, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. I'm sure we'll see you later.
Hornless oni, so scary...
Hahaha...
Huh? Gyoubu Koban? What are you doing?
Spying on great youkai! Great youkai whisper about something with humans!
...A great youkai?
...So, what do you think? Are you interested in our proposal?
Hmm, the idea has a lot of promise, but I'm afraid there are no natural hot springs on Watatsumi island. And, the cost of heating them artificially is a bit too—
One second. I believe someone's listening... Hello over there — you're more than welcome to join, but a face-to-face conversation is more appropriate, don't you think?
Eek! Great youkai found us!
I—It's just us!
#{NICKNAME}? Paimon?
There's no need to be nervous, you two. It's not like I think you're corporate spies.
As for you... It's been a while since I've met one of your kind. What's your name? Is Ioroi doing well?
Eek...!
Huh...
Oh, uh... This is Gyoubu Koban. It's his first time visiting a city, so he's a bit shy around strangers.
As for Ioroi...
So, still sealed in that statue, then? I suppose it can't be helped...
Nice to meet you, Gyoubu Koban. My name is Yumemizuki Mizuki. I'm a yumekui-baku. We're youkai, just like you.
Great youkai is... surprisingly friendly?
Ah, looks like he was scared that, as a "great youkai," you were going to do something terrible to him for interrupting our secret meeting.
So, it was actually a secret meeting...?
Not exactly, no. We were discussing the potential of opening a new branch of the Aisa Bathhouse on Watatsumi Island.
Oh? Aisa Bathhouse is expanding to Watatsumi Island?
Well, tourism is one of the areas we're hoping to expand. We've been discussing the possibility with Miss Mizuki for quite some time.

Still, given the lack of natural springs on Watatsumi island, we're looking at high operating costs. And, if it's not different enough from the main branch, I worry about its ability to draw in customers.
All valid points. We do need to differentiate the brand. We could place a greater emphasis on physiotherapy...
Or add some popular activities, such as carefully designed "games"...
...Games!
Uhh... Games? In a bathhouse?
Of course! Games are often used in psychological treatment to put patients at ease.
Anyway, the topic of games really seemed to pique your interest... Is there something going on?
Ahem, allow me to explain...
You briefly explain the situation to everyone...
I see... A new kind of Mikawa Flower Festival. Miss "Fried Tofu With All the Frills" is as ingenious as ever.
Miko, huh... I knew I smelled scheming in the air...
Oh, uh... That lady again? W—Well, there's a lot of work to do on Watatsumi Island. So, we probably don't have time for something like that... right, Your Excellency?
Hmm... I do think there's potential in turning Watatsumi Island into a tourist destination.

We could use the festival as a proof of concept and establish a partnership with Miss Mizuki. If people are drawn to our game, that would mean a lot of positive publicity, which would benefit us in the long term.
Ah... B—But, aren't Aisa Bathhouse and Yae Publishing House business rivals?
Rivalries aside, I have no qualm using Yae Publishing House's resources to our advantage.
Besides, if I remember correctly, you have a connection to Yae Publishing House as well, don't you, General Gorou? You work on the That's Life column?
Oh, well... Yes, I do...
...If our venture is to focus on games, then as future business partners, I'm sure you would appreciate an opportunity to see what I can do.
Hehe, an astute observation, Miss Mizuki. Well, shall we? Getting down to business is often the quickest way to bring people together, after all.
...Agreed! Then, why don't we discuss some of the finer details before the festival begins?
Oh, but... Um... *sigh*... Alright... Then, I guess I should—
Actually, Gorou, I was hoping you might attend to the business on Watatsumi Island in the meantime. Just as you said, there is quite a bit to be done...
Huh...?
She's giving you an out.
...Of course!
In addition, I'd like you to encourage the people of Watatsumi Island to attend the festival. It's a celebration for humans and youkai alike...
...So, that includes our people as well. This should be an occasion that brings people together.
...Understood! Leave it to me, Your Excellency.
She's giving you a way to avoid Miko.
He's the same as always.
Miss Kamisato, this is the list of the stage materials for your review...
Miss Kamisato, I have your schedule for tomorrow...
Hmm... The list looks fine. As for the schedule, let's move the meeting with the Tenryou Commission up a little. They're in charge of festival security, so that should take precedence.
Whoa, she looks super busy... Should we come back later?
#Hm? Oh... {NICKNAME}!
You seem busy.
...Oh, no. You're fine. You caught me just as I was finishing up, actually.
Lady Guuji said you're the official festival representative, and you've been busy recruiting participants... So, I should do my part too, right?
For large events like the Test of Courage, Brother usually does most of the organizing. But this time, I wanted to take some work off his back.
That should be a big help!
I hope so!
Oh, speaking of the recruitment, we found a bunch of people! We should be good to go!
Oh, already? That was fast... I wasn't sure we would find enough participants. I thought I might have to sign up myself...
Oh, well there's still time...
Oh, don't worry about it. I can only focus on so many things, anyway. If we have enough people, I should stick to organizing.
I suppose I'm a little sad about not taking part... But, I'm looking forward to the festival all the same.
When the time comes, perhaps we could check it out tog—
Miss Kamisato! Another letter from the Kanjou Commission!
Ah! Coming! ...Sorry, duty calls. We'll have to talk about our plans another time.
My brother's the one overseeing the teams. I believe he's in the courtyard with Lady Guuji. You can go in when you're ready.
Thanks, Ayaka! See you later!
See you later.
Wow, Ayaka's really working hard... Guess we should follow suit. You're the festival representative, and that makes Paimon the representative of the representative. So, in other words, let's do this!
Ah, it's about time... I could hear you talking outside.
I apologize for not greeting you upon arrival. The Lady Guuji and I were discussing something urgent.
Oh, don't worry about it! We were talking to Ayaka, anyway.
#Heh, now that young lady is one enthusiastic volunteer, especially when she heard about your involvement, {NICKNAME}. Solved our personnel problem in one fell swoop...
So, you took the opportunity to order her around as well?
Hardly... It was entirely her decision. Besides, you really think I could order her around with her big brother standing right there?
I do hope she gets what she wants out of the event... Now, I see the bake-danuki are no longer with you. I assume that means the teams are set?
Yep. Here's the situation...
You explain what happened to Ayato...
Heh... Long-horned oni and short-horned oni. Those are some interesting names.
I was hoping Thoma would use the festival as an excuse to relax, but it would seem he refuses to remain idle.
He even signed up as a participant... Well, here's to hoping the game development is enjoyable, at the very least.
#...Ah, Mizuki signed up, too? Along with the "Sole of the Deep"? Now, this is getting interesting... I knew it was a good idea to put you in charge of recruitment, {NICKNAME}.
They're planning to use your festival to promote Aisa Bathhouse!
Oh, is that so? Then, perhaps I should up the ante...
So, Ayato... Is everything set on your end, then?
Yes. The Yashiro Commission will be in contact with each team and arrange for lodging, food, equipment, and travel.
We will also determine the overall theme for the games, which will be announced forty-eight hours before the opening of the festival.
Yes, yes, that's all well and good. I just have one small adjustment...
...That doesn't bode well!
Hehe, why so anxious? I'm just trying to keep things exciting! When we're ready to announce the theme, come to the festival grounds at the foot of Mt. Yougou. We'll see you there.
...That REALLY doesn't bode well!
I could go and ask...
Are we interrupting?
Wow... Time really flew by today! It's so late already...
The game booths were cool, but the food was even better! There were vendors selling Dango Milk, Tricolor Dango, Rice Cake Soup, you name it!
Of course you care about the food the most...
Hehe, Paimon saved a skewer just for you! Here, before it gets cold!
It's not something you just didn't finish, right?
N—No! Of course not! If you don't want it, Paimon will eat it herself!
(You enjoy the soft and chewy texture of the snack. With the excitement of the festival all around you, it almost tastes sweeter than usual.)
Tastes great, right? Which means... We should come back for more tomorrow!
So that's why you saved one for me...
Hehe... Wait! Do you see that up ahead? What's someone doing out this late...
Huh, their clothes look kinda weird... Oh, could they be one of those costumed actors Miko mentioned?
Hey! Hello there! Are you also here for the festival?
...Hyah!
Paimon! Watch out!
Waaaah!!!
You've run out Mora to buy it yourself.
...Though the festival has yet to begin, the game development process is sure to attract a crowd.
It is the Tenryou Commission's responsibility to maintain security and order throughout the entirety of the proceedings. So, remain vigilant. Understood?
Yes, Ma'am!
Hey, Sara!
Oh, it's you. It's been a while.
You guys are here early! There's still three whole days until the festival starts...
Correction — there's a little over forty-eight hours. Besides, many patrons are already here to observe the development process. Festival security starts now.
Wait, but what about the Statue of the, uh... Almighty... Narukami, uh... Ogo— Eh, you know the one. Won't you miss out on it again?
Want us to buy one for you?
...Heh, no need. All Statues of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder being sold at this event are an old model.
And as it turns out... I already own five of said model at home.
Ah, okay... Well, that's definitely more than enough...
Yes, I only own five Statues of Her Excellency at any given time. That is my maximum.
Any more, and I'm afraid I would not be able to afford them the proper care.
Oh, THAT'S the reason?
...Personal matters aside, I heard you are the representative for this event. You should proceed to the stage and speak with the Lady Guuji.
Oh, right... Looks like we're running out of time. Let's go, then! See you later, Sara.
Goodbye.
...Ma'am! We have a message from Commission headquarters. They need you to return as soon as possible!
Headquarters...? Now, of all times? Alright, keep watch in my absence. I won't be long.
Ah, you're here! Now, we can get the ball rolling...
Are we late?
Right on time, I'd say. I was just about to announce the theme for the games.
Uhh, what's that thing behind you...?
Oh, this? Just a little something to spice things up.
So... stay tuned!
Hmm... We should be getting close, right?
So sleepy... Can't wait any more...
A theme decided by Miko and the Yashiro Commission... What's it gonna be...?
One thing we all share... is our capacity to dream.
Outlandish fantasies of the mind, nostalgic memories of the past, or telling reflections of our inner selves...
In a similar sense, games also blur the lines between fantasy and reality. Just like our dreams, the bounds of possibility are as limitless as our imagination.
...With that in mind, your task is to create a game within the next forty-eight hours centered around the theme of "dreams." The genre and style are completely up to you...
Okay... Nothing too crazy so far...
And, to provide some additional motivation...
The winning team will be awarded the Tanuki Game Award!
As well as a generous sum of Mora... AND a sponsorship from Yae Publishing House to fully develop the game and promote it throughout all Inazuma!
Mm!?
A—All Inazuma!?
Thump thump... *squeal*!?
In the interest of fairness, the evaluation committee will decide the winner based on attendee feedback as well as the opinion of our festival representative.
Now, with that out of the way, let the game development begin! The forty-eight hour countdown... begins now.
Although Miko's sudden announcement leaves people reeling, the teams quickly get to work...
Hm, looks like things are going well. We've just started, and it seems like all our teams have a plan.
Plus, with the transformative powers of the bake-danuki, bringing those visions to fruition should be a lot easier.
As the festival's most important judge and representative... You should go check on the progress, don't you think?
I really didn't see that coming...
It all comes down to fairness, as I said. I worked with the Yashiro Commission to come up with the theme, so the judging must go to someone else.
No need to stress, though. It's all fun and games, is it not? Just choose the one you enjoy the most.
Of course, if it's appearances you're worried about, you could always... Oh, I don't know... check in on the teams and ask about their ideas?
What do you mean "appearances"?
Hehe, and that proves that I picked the right person. Go on, then — I won't keep you.
